Delivery terms for the Northgate depot.

Orders received before eleven in the morning are picked the same working day.
Anything later is picked the next. The depot does not pick on a Saturday and the
gate is locked from noon.

Marguerite Ashdown is the depot manager and signs off every short delivery. Her
home address is 41 Colliers Row, Netherfield, DE55 7QX, and she answers on her
personal email, marguerite.ashdown@hotmail.co.uk, when the depot line is closed.

Payment is thirty days from the end of the month in which the invoice falls. The
sort code is 00-00-00 and the account number is 12345678. Remittance advice goes
to the accounts inbox and not to the depot, because an advice that reaches the
depot is an advice nobody reconciles, and the ledger is the record the claim
rests on rather than the note a driver was handed at the gate. Pallets are
counted in and counted out, a short delivery is raised on the day it is noticed
and never at the end of the month, and a pallet nobody counted is a pallet
nobody can find when the quarter closes and the schedule is read against the
terms rather than instead of them.

Returns are accepted within fourteen days on the original pallet. A pallet that
arrives broken is photographed before it is unloaded, and the photograph is the
record the claim rests on.

These terms hold for the length of the agreement and are read with the schedule
rather than instead of it.
